_about: Constants shared by the Python fleet twin (twin/) and the web app (app/). Every entry records value, unit, evidence, source, conditions and range (when known). DECK sN = Sundai Hack 145 Track 1 organizer slides, slide N.

_evidence.organizer: Given by the hackathon organizers (DECK). Used as stated, not independently checked.
_evidence.published_proposal: Number from a published design study or paper, not flown hardware.
_evidence.team_projection: Our extrapolation to 2035. Plausible, not sourced to a single measurement.
_evidence.sensitivity: A knob we vary to see what matters. The default is a placeholder, not a fact.

launch_usd_per_kg.conditions: 2035 fully reusable heavy lift, payload to LEO; excludes integration and insurance

radiator._about: Radiator surface that reproduces the deck's 972 W/m^2 (two-sided).

sink_k.conditions: effective sink, LEO with Earth IR and albedo averaged

accelerator_2035._about: The app's 2035 accelerator (compute module defaults chipTdpW / chipPflops mirror these).

tdp_w.conditions: chip package power only; server overhead and spacecraft bus load are added separately

pflops_fp8.conditions: peak dense FP8 per accelerator; delivered throughput applies MFU separately

radiation._about: Total ionizing dose (TID) for the lifetime module. Google Suncatcher (arXiv 2511.19468): HBM stress tests first showed irregularities near ~2 krad(Si); other tests continued to 15 krad(Si) with no hard failures attributed to TID. Neither number is an established accelerator failure threshold.

dose_rate_sso_rad_yr.conditions: ~650 km dawn-dusk SSO behind substantial shielding (~10 mm Al equivalent). The app has no shielding geometry model; thinner shielding means a higher dose.

dose_rate_geo_rad_yr.conditions: GEO, shielded; order of magnitude only

tid_onset_krad.source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.19468 (HBM irregularities first seen near this dose)
tid_onset_krad.conditions: dose where the model starts degrading capacity; the paper reports test irregularities, not a failure threshold

tid_loss_pct_per_krad.conditions: gradual derate (memory errors, retired HBM, retries); no measured rate exists

tid_hard_fail_krad.source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.19468 (tested to 15 krad without hard failures attributed to TID)
tid_hard_fail_krad.conditions: team assumption that hard failures begin beyond the tested dose; a tested-without-failure dose, not a guaranteed safe limit

space_failure_mult.conditions: lumps thermal cycling, launch loads and single-event latch-up; not measured

mass_t_per_mw._about: Tonnes per MW of IT power, dry (no propellant). The app's 'deck' and 'light' presets reproduce the deck and light lines exactly. Subsystem numbers stay plain so existing readers keep working; the evidence fields describe the whole split.

deck.conditions: per MW of IT power (not total spacecraft load); dry mass, propellant excluded

light.levers: 500 W/kg thin-film solar, 2 kg/m^2 carbon-fiber radiators, space-stripped racks (-30% compute), chips at 330 K (less leakage, power factor 0.919)
light.conditions: team scenario, per MW of IT power; dry mass, propellant excluded

conservative.conditions: sensitivity only, not a default and not wired to a preset; total is the range midpoint; no subsystem split given
